gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Nostalgic and a bit bookish, Mystery Quest leans on open-jawed curves and compact ascenders for its charm. Noto Sans Hanunoo is a plain sans that fills the line height and keeps its terminals easy to follow.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Mystery Quest brings a storybook flavor, with curves that gape open and ascenders tucked in close. But Noto Sans Hebrew is the one doing the steady work, its big midsection and wide curve gaps keeping a plain sans easy to follow.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hk: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest its storybook, nostalgic face. Noto Sans HK follows with large lowercase and lifted brush ends, so a long passage moves along smoothly in a clean sans.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-imperial-: Storybook charm meets tidy modern lettering, with Mystery Quest up top and Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic below, whose c ends point apart like pincers. Nostalgia and approachability, neatly split.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-inscripti: Old-fashioned heading, wide-eyed body. Mystery Quest keeps its curves open and its ascenders compact, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian adds big open eyes on e and a and a deep middle band that makes the text feel generous.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP reads tall and open, its very tall x-height and sweeping curves giving the text a modern, professional feel. Shrink Mystery Quest and its charm fades.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Bookish up top, blunt below. Mystery Quest is best at nostalgic display with its open-jawed curves, while Noto Sans Kaithi does better with body text, its open e channel and capital-like lowercase filling each line.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada keeps a gentle bump from small letters to capitals, and its s curves open wide at both ends. Mystery Quest supplies the nostalgic headline.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Mystery Quest carries a nostalgic, bookish air, with open-jawed curves and compact ascenders over tall lowercase. And Noto Sans Kayah Li does the quieter job, its lifted brush ends and modest capitals keeping a plain sans clean.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kharoshth: Mystery Quest gets nostalgic with open-jawed curves, and it is best as a bookish display voice. Noto Sans Kharoshthi works better as sans-serif text, laying a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line.
